steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In May 2026, a guest on Equity Mates described ReadyTech as a government ERP cloud migrator, like a smaller TechOne, serving universities, TAFEs and colleges, outlining its cloud software role for education and public sector clients.

Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In May 2026, a guest on Equity Mates highlighted ReadyTech was on about two times EV to sales and described it as cheap, noting a checkered earnings history, a prior private equity bid at 450, and a view that parts could be worth more than its market cap.
